_comment: Placeable things. size = [w, d] tiles. model = asset id or 'proc:<name>' (procedural). fit = fraction of the footprint the model fills. buildSec = construction time. charm = Charm points while placed. cat: special|farm|animal|production|decor.

farmhouse._comment: Farmhouse level gates building caps. caps index = farmhouse level - 1.

upgrades._comment: Production buildings: each level adds a queue slot. Animal housing: each level adds a stall. Cost multiplies by the building's upgradeMult.
